Description: Ensembl Gene ID
Gene.Name: Ensembl ID

Description: Type of the primary RNA generated from the gene
Gene.Name: Gene Type

Description: Location of the gene in the human hg38 genome linked to the UCSC genome browser. The UCSC link contains transcription factor binding information (ChIP-seq tracks and motif tracks) and a summary thereof (peak-of-peak denotes the summary of peaks identified in the respective ChIP-seq datasets)
Gene.Name: Genomic Position (UCSC link)

Description: Summary of the 57 p53 gene expression profiling datasets. Reflects the number of datasets that identify a gene as significantly up-regulated minus the number of datasets that identify the gene as significantly down-regulated. Range -55 to +57.
Gene.Name: p53 Expression Score (-55 to 57)

Description: The median log2 fold-change observed in the 57 p53 gene expression profiling datasets.
Gene.Name: p53 median log2FC

Description: A p53 binding site that is supported by at least five p53 ChIP-seq datasets (see UCSC link for detailed information) is located within 2.5 kb of any of the transcription start sites (TSS) annotated for the gene.
Gene.Name: p53-bound TSS

Description: A p53 binding site that is supported by at least five p53 ChIP-seq datasets (see UCSC link for detailed information) is located in an enhancer that is linked to the gene. Based on double-elite enhancer:gene associations from GeneHancer.
Gene.Name: p53-bound enhancer

Description: The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the transcription factor and tumor suppressor RFX7. p53 activates RFX7 to expand the p53 transcriptional program.
Gene.Name: RFX7 target

Description: The Cell Cycle Expression Score reflects the number of datasets that identified the gene as being expressed in an oscillating pattern through the cell cycle. Range 0 to 9.
Gene.Name: Cell Cycle Expression Score (0 to 9)

Description: Cell cycle genes are categorized as G1/S or G2/M, reflecting the two major waves of cell cycle-dependent gene expression during the cell cycle. Therefore, peak phases identified by the individual datasets (see below section ‘cell cycle-dependent gene regulation’) were summarized. ‘G1’, ‘G1/S’, and ‘S’ were jointly considered as ‘G1/S’, while ‘G2’, ‘G2/M’, ‘M’, and ‘M/G1’ were jointly considered as ‘G2/M’. Category information is displayed for all genes that were identified as cell cycle genes in at least three datasets. Categorization is based on a majority vote by the datasets, and a draw is designated as ‘UNCLEAR’.
Gene.Name: Cell Cycle Gene Category

Description: The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the trans-repressor complex DREAM. The complex is known to repress cell cycle genes during G0 and G1 phases as well as in response to p53 signaling.
Gene.Name: DREAM target

Description: The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the trans-activator complex MMB:FOXM1. The complex is known to activate cell cycle genes during G2 and M phases.
Gene.Name: MMB:FOXM1 target

Description: The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the trans-repressor complex RB:E2F. The complex is known to repress cell cycle genes during G0 and G1 phases as well as in response to p53 signaling.
Gene.Name: RB:E2F target

Description: Summary of 16 deltaNp63 gene expression profiling datasets. Reflects the number of datasets that identify a gene as significantly up-regulated minus the number of datasets that identify the gene as significantly down-regulated. Range -12 to +14.
Gene.Name: ΔNp63 Expression Score (-12 to 14)

Description: The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the p53 sibling and oncogenic transcription factor deltaNp63.
Gene.Name: ΔNp63 target

Description: The gene has been identified as a potential direct target of the p53 sibling and oncogenic transcription factor deltaNp63.
Gene.Name: potential ΔNp63 target

Gene.Name: p53 Expression Score Protein (-5 to 5)

Description: The median log2 fold-change observed in the five p53 protein expression profiling datasets.
Gene.Name: p53 median log2FC (protein)
